LINK_FOLLOWS_SYMLINKS.evidence: Linux link() links the symlink itself; linkat flags are explicit.

major_t/minor_t.evidence: m4/jm-macros.m4 fallback; musl sys/sysmacros.h uses unsigned major/minor.

MAJOR_IN_SYSMACROS.evidence: sysroot sys/sysmacros.h declares major/minor/makedev; mountlist.c needs that header.

MOUNTED_GETMNTENT1/HAVE_SETMNTENT/HAVE_H.evidence: sysroot mntent.h and static compiler/link/runtime probe: setmntent/getmntent/endmntent on /proc/mounts.

STAT_STATVFS/HAVE_FSTATFS/HAVE_STRUCT_ST.evidence: sysroot sys/statfs.h/sys/statvfs.h and static compiler/link/runtime probe on /.

HAVE_STRUCT_UTMP[X]_*.evidence: sysroot utmpx.h: ut_type/id/pid/user/host/session/exit fields and e_exit/e_termination GNU aliases; utmp.h aliases utmpx; ut_tv exists.

HAVE_UTMPNAME/HAVE_UTMPXNAME.evidence: Declarations and link symbols exist, but iteration is stubbed; skip who/users/pinky. uptime uses gnulib Linux boot-time fallback.

gmp.h.evidence: lib/gnulib.mk GL_GENERATE_MINI_GMP_H rule when external GMP is unavailable.

stdbuf/libstdbuf.so.evidence: sysroot usr/lib has only static libc.a and compatibility archives, no libc.so; LD_PRELOAD helper cannot work with static programs.

TIME_H_DEFINES_STRUCT_TIMESPEC.evidence: musl time.h includes native struct timespec and itimerspec. Wrong 0 generated rpl_timespec, conflicting with native itimerspec.it_value in timeout. Retain native timers.
